title: Solver using a supplied machine
statement: Given a Boolean Turing machine $E$, define a Boolean Turing machine whose loop host runs in find mode with the bit-length machine as its fuel machine. Its body is an emitter construction using calls to $E$ and to the bit-length machine, together with their corresponding work-tape counts and entry and exit states.
caveat: The supplied definitions do not explain the emitter-body construction or the call, work-tape-count, entry, and exit operations, so the behavior of the resulting solver cannot be stated more explicitly.
